description: Mercimek Corbasi is a beloved classic Turkish red lentil soup, known for its vibrant color, creamy texture, and deeply comforting flavor. This hearty and nutritious soup is a staple in Turkish households, often served as a starter or a light meal. Its simplicity belies a rich taste, making it a favorite for all seasons.

instructions.title: Prepare Lentils and Vegetables
instructions.text: Rinse the red lentils thoroughly under cold running water until the water runs clear. Set aside. Prepare the vegetables by finely chopping the onion and dicing the carrot and potato.

instructions.title: Saute Aromatics
instructions.text: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the diced carrot and potato, and continue to cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: Add Tomato Paste and Lentils
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly to toast the paste and deepen its flavor. Add the rinsed red lentils to the pot and stir to combine with the vegetables and paste.

instructions.title: Simmer the Soup
instructions.text: Pour in the hot water or vegetable broth. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and vegetables are very tender.

instructions.title: Blend to Smoothness
instructions.text: Remove the pot from the heat. Using an immersion blender, carefully blend the soup until it is completely smooth and creamy. Alternatively, transfer the soup in batches to a regular blender and blend until smooth. Be cautious when blending hot liquids.

instructions.title: Season and Adjust Consistency
instructions.text: Return the blended soup to the stove over low heat. Stir in the salt and black pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. If the soup is too thick, add a little more hot water or broth until it reaches your desired consistency.

instructions.title: Prepare Mint Butter Topping
instructions.text: While the soup is simmering or after blending, prepare the mint butter. In a small pan, melt the butter over medium-low heat. Once melted, add the dried mint and red pepper flakes (if using). Cook for about 30 seconds, stirring until fragrant, being careful not to burn the mint.

instructions.title: Serve Mercimek Corbasi
instructions.text: Ladle the hot Mercimek Corbasi into individual bowls. Drizzle each serving generously with the spiced mint butter. Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges on the side for squeezing, as a squeeze of lemon brightens the flavors beautifully.

tips: For an extra smooth soup, ensure your vegetables are very finely diced before cooking, or pass the blended soup through a fine-mesh sieve.
The secret to the best Mercimek Corbasi is the quality of the tomato paste; use authentic Turkish salça for a deeper flavor and rich color.
Always serve Mercimek Corbasi hot, garnished with a generous drizzle of the spiced mint butter and a wedge of fresh lemon to enhance the taste.
